bullets.text: French Telco Consortium Bids Higher - **Bouygues**, **Orange**, and **Iliad** increase SFR offer to €20.4 billion.
5G-A Powers AI Revolution - The shift to **5G-Advanced** is crucial for handling surging AI-driven traffic demands.
AI Transforms Telco Personalization - **Calix** CEO highlights AI's potential for hyper-personalized customer experiences.
Inventory Data Gains Value - Telcos are recognizing the strategic importance of network inventory data for operational efficiency.
Nokia and Orange Collaborate - New partnership focuses on developing **AI-RAN** technologies to enhance network performance.
Vodafone Enhances Scam Call Protection - New AI-driven feature aims to reduce fraudulent calls for customers.
